title: Bleeding Berserkir axes

infobox.Hitbox: 2.2 range, 90 angle, 0.6 height, no multitarget penalty

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
Bleeding Berserkir axes are the upgraded form of Berserkir axes using the Bloodstone. Like all upgraded-weapons that use Bloodstone, their hit effect is damage increased by 0.2% for every point of health the player is missing (not the percentage missing).
An upgraded Berserkir axes will NOT keep its upgrade level when it is used to craft the Bleeding Berserkir axes using gemstones.
